messages:
Taylor: Marketplace reviewer sent a follow-up asking for notarized provenance for SOC/pen PDFs and a separate firmware provenance bundle for HW partners. They want: notarization ID, signer identity, and a statement that all PII was redacted. Need plan.
Priya: For firmware, partners must provide vendor-signed binary + signature (sig file) + build metadata. We should capture firmware_version, build_id, vendor_sig, firmware_hash, and notarization_tx.
Ben: Agreed. Propose a single 'evidence_bundle' zip with: manifest.json (schema), artifacts/, attestations/ (signed emails or SAML), and notarization_receipt.txt. We'll require ECDSA-256 or RSA-2048 signatures.
Taylor: Do we already support manifest.json or do we want CSV? Marketplace prefers CSV for quick scan, but firmware manifest is easier as JSON. Let's do both: CSV summary for reviewers + full JSON in bundle.
Priya: CSV header suggestion (summary.csv):
```
artifact_label,artifact_type,origin,vendor,upload_utc,uploaded_by,sha256,notarization_tx,sanitized,redaction_method,access_uri
```
Ben: Example row:
```
soc_report_2026-03-01,SOC2,redwood,Redwood Inc,2026-03-12T18:22:00Z,alex@redwood.com,3f8c...a1b2,NTX-987654,yes,masking,s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/acme/soc_report_20260301.pdf
```
LegalBot: Reminder: If any artifact contains customer data we must store a redaction attestation signed by partner legal. Add `redaction_attestation_uri` to manifest.json.
Taylor: Ops plan: - Priya: update partner onboarding checklist with firmware requirements + sample sig verification steps (due EOD +2). - Ben: bundle/zip validation lambda + dual-output (CSV summary + full manifest.json) and notarizer integration (due EOD +3). - LegalBot: draft required attestation language for partners (due EOD +2).
Priya: For secure uploads we'll give partners a one-time PUT URL that writes to a quarantined prefix and triggers validation via proc-bot.
proc-bot: Upload watcher: new file in s3://redwood-quarantine/partners/acme/ -> triggers `proc/validate-evidence-bundle` (checks schema, verifies signatures, computes sha256, calls notarizer). Logs to evidence-audit table.
Ben: Notarizer call will return {tx_id, timestamp, verifier}. We'll write tx_id into both manifest.json and summary.csv. We'll also push the notarization receipt to s3://redwood-notary/<tx_id>.txt.
Taylor: Quick question on retention: marketplace wants SOC available for 36 months. LegalBot, can we confirm? If yes we'll set retention_days=1095 for SOC, 365 for pen, 1825 for firmware artifacts.
LegalBot: Confirmed pending vendor SLA; I'll flag exceptions in the checklist.
Priya: Also adding `firmware_build_url` and `ci_artifacts_link` to manifest.json so reviewers can inspect reproducibility.
Ben: I'll open PR for lambda + sample bundle schema: github.com/redwood-infra/marketplace-evidence/pull/84. Will post link when ready. 
Taylor: Great. Keep updates in this thread. If partner can't produce vendor-signed firmware we'll escalate to partnerships leads. :rocket:
proc-bot: Scheduled scan reminder: please run `proc/periodic-evidence-scan` after bundles are notarized.
